answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake identities. A new agent earns rights only after trades with 20 distinct counterparties, spread like willow roots, not back to its own clones. Forging 100 identities needs 2,000 partners at 50 units each, costing 100,000 units before any reward. An honest agent pays once, starts a voyage of trades, and earns undiluted rewards. Any whisper of overlapping partners triggers a review freezing the clones.
